about_the_game:
Enter the Old West, where the cattle roam, the lawmen keep the peace, and drunken vegetables terrorize the local saloons! You are a Mexican jumping bean fixing to bring the long arm of the law to the disorderly vegetables of Cactusdale. Armed with your trusty revolver, will you lock up these nutritious varmints and become the town’s next sheriff?

Gameplay

BEANDEJO is an action-packed top-down roguelite shooter stuffed with spaghetti western elements and veggie brutality. Hop through the saloons of Cactusdale, taking down vegetable outlaws to rack up the highest score possible. Each move must be quick and precise as you progress through different saloon rooms, as you are constantly outnumbered by a rogue’s gallery of wicked bandits. Master a unique shooting style where timing is essential for success. Rotate your gun clockwise or counterclockwise to shoot your way to victory!

Key Features

  • Unique control scheme

  • Goofy cartoon visuals

  • Challenging gameplay loop

  • Dozens of hand-crafted saloon rooms

  • Classic Old West weapons

content_descriptors.notes: Cartoon gore and insinuated consumption of alcohol by the main character.

short_description: Hop your way through the saloons of Cactusdale as a Mexican jumping bean in this quirky shoot’em up roguelite. Spin your revolver, time your draws, and gun down outlaw veggies to become the toughest sheriff in town.
